summary.text: EMINENT EIENDOMSMEGLING LILLEHAMMER AS is a private limited company registered in Lillehammer, founded 2005-08-08. Eminent Eiendomsmegling Lillehammer AS is engaged in property brokerage (eiendomsmegling), together with activities naturally connected to this, including participating in other companies with similar operations. It was previously named ARENA EIENDOMSMEGLING LILLEHAMMER AS until 2015-01-13. Its main industry code is 68.310: intermediation service activities for real estate activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 49 031 450 NOK and the annual result was 3 641 462 NOK; operating income was up from 42 451 621 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 3 784 042 NOK in 2024 to 3 641 462 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 3 576 006 NOK in 2024 to 7 217 468 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 15 on 2026-03-13 to 11 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
